1 · New cohort

One receptor and one shared configuration for every molecule. That is what makes the rows comparable with each other.

NAME
Prepare the file
Include at most 500 molecules in a file of up to 8 MiB.
For CSV, use UTF-8, a header row first, commas as the separator and the recommended column smiles; these are also accepted: canonical_smiles and structure.
Every molecule will use a single receptor and the same frozen configuration.

MINIMAL CSV EXAMPLE

smiles,name,active,control_role
CC(=O)Nc1ccc(O)cc1,paracetamol,1,reference

A saved cohort is immutable: changing the receptor, the configuration or the file produces another cohort, not an edit.

This screen does not rank molecules by pharmacological merit and produces no aggregate score. The observed Vina affinity is a ranking signal within this protocol, not a free-energy measurement and not a prediction of activity.
